title: ICM + OKF v0.2 Domain A2UI Component Catalog
description: Tier 2 A2UI v1.0 domain catalog providing ICM + OKF v0.2 components (Badge, SpeechPlayer, OkfMarkdown, OkfKnowledgeGraph, InteractiveChecklist, ModuleCarousel, QuizRunner, CaseSimulator) and agent RPC functions (verifyOkfSources) mixed natively alongside the A2UI v1.0 Basic Catalog via @catalogId.
instructions: Use this catalog alongside the A2UI v1.0 Basic Catalog ('https://a2ui.org/specification/v1_0/catalogs/basic/catalog.json') by setting '@catalogId': 'https://a2ui.org/specification/v1_0/catalogs/icm-okf-v0.2/catalog.json' on Tier 2 domain components (Badge, SpeechPlayer, OkfMarkdown, OkfKnowledgeGraph, InteractiveChecklist, ModuleCarousel, QuizRunner, CaseSimulator) and 'catalogId' on verifyOkfSources function calls.

Badge.description: Renders a semantic status pill badge (e.g. status: stable, trust: human-reviewed, fresh).

text.description: The text label rendered inside the pill badge.

tone.description: Semantic visual tone for the status badge.

SpeechPlayer.description: Synthesizes spoken narration via Web Speech API with automatic BCP-47 voice binding (nb-NO/no-NO/en-US) or plays an optional pre-rendered Stage 4 audio URL.

ttsText.description: Plain spoken text synthesized via Web Speech API.

description.description: Human-readable title or description of the narration track.

audioUrl.description: Optional http:, https:, data:, or relative URL for pre-rendered Stage 4 audio.

voicesLabel.description: Optional label identifying the synthesized studio voice(s) (e.g. 'Kore' or 'Sulafat & Kore').

OkfMarkdown.description: Renders OKF v0.2 Markdown with clickable [^id] footnotes, domain-provenance & timestamp chips, interactive source curation (replace/reject/add), Layer 4 raw Markdown editing, and internal concept navigation.

title.description: Title of the OKF v0.2 concept document.

body.description: OKF v0.2 Markdown body with inline [^id] footnote citations and bottom [^id]: Title definitions.

frontmatter.description: Optional raw OKF v0.2 YAML frontmatter object.

sources.description: Array of OKF v0.2 source objects ({ id, title, resource, retrieved_at, last_modified }) or JSON Pointer binding.

trustTier.description: Computed OKF v0.2 trust tier (unverified | auto | machine-confirmed | human-reviewed).

isStale.description: Computed OKF v0.2 staleness flag evaluated against frontmatter.stale_after.

editablePath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer path for Layer 4 in-place Markdown editing (defaults to /okf/body).

rejectedSourcesPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer path storing interactive rejected source IDs (defaults to /okf/rejectedSources).

replacedSourcesPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer path storing interactive replaced source mappings (defaults to /okf/replacedSources).

addedSourcesPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer path storing interactive human-added sources (defaults to /okf/addedSources).

verifierActorPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer path storing the human verifier identity (defaults to /okf/verifierActor).

OkfKnowledgeGraph.description: Embeds the interactive Cytoscape.js + zero-CDN SVG OKF v0.2 Knowledge Graph explorer directly inside an A2UI tab.

title.description: Header title for the embedded OKF v0.2 knowledge graph explorer.

bundlePath.description: Optional relative path to the standalone workspace/bundle/viz.html graph explorer.

InteractiveChecklist.description: Renders extracted Markdown or Stage 2 checklists with nested category headers, LaTeX/footnote cleaning, and reactive CheckBox completion bound two-way to the A2UI data model.

title.description: Header title for the interactive checklist card.

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle or completion summary binding.

groupsPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer path to the checklist groups array in the surface data model (e.g. /checklist/groups).

ModuleCarousel.description: Renders Stage 2 trainingModules, lessons, modules, or analytical pillars with step-by-step navigation, metadata badges, optional Stage 3 16:9 module illustrations (imageUrl), slide cues, action items, and SpeechPlayer narration (Stage 4 audioUrl or Web Speech API).

title.description: Header title for the training modules or analytical pillars carousel.

modulesPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer path to the normalized Stage 2 modules/pillars array (e.g. /stage2/modules).

activeIndexPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer path to the currently active module index (e.g. /stage2/activeModuleIndex).

QuizRunner.description: Interactive assessment runner bound to Stage 2 quiz items with ChoicePicker selection, explanation feedback, and live score calculation.

title.description: Header title for the interactive knowledge check runner.

questionsPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer path to the quiz questions array (e.g. /stage2/quiz).

answersPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer path to the user's selected quiz answers map (e.g. /stage2/quizAnswers).

CaseSimulator.description: Interactive scenario, dilemma, or stress-test simulator bound to Stage 2 cases with editable response notes and model resolution reveal.

title.description: Header title for the interactive scenario, dilemma, or stress-test simulator.

casesPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer path to the normalized cases/scenarios array (e.g. /stage2/cases).

responsesPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer path to the user's drafted scenario responses map (e.g. /stage2/caseResponses).

verifyOkfSources.description: Submits human OKF v0.2 source curation decisions (verifierActor, rejectedSources, replacedSources, addedSources) from the renderer to the Co-Architect agent via callAgentFunction.

Weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column.
